summary: Iteration 5 (Real recurring events + Live event feeds aggregator) tested end-to-end. All 8 backend pytest assertions PASS and all frontend UI behaviours verified. /api/event-feeds endpoint works for both audiences with correct counts (8 youth / 10 immigrant), ISANS events feed correctly scoped to immigrant only, Eventbrite Halifax appears in both. /api/events returns expected recurring events with host_url field, no duration_minutes anymore, starts_at is free-text. Frontend EventsPage renders [data-testid='event-feeds-section'] with anchor cards [data-testid^='event-feed-'] (target=_blank), 'Recurring programs' section with anchor cards [data-testid^='event-card-'] (target=_blank, href=host_url), hero copy adapts to audience, audience toggle re-fetches both feeds and events, no RSVP buttons exist on /events page.
critical_code_review_comments: Note (env, not iteration 5 code): frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL points to https://youth-worx-connect.preview.emergentagent.com while the public preview URL listed in the request is https://47abc6db-...preview.emergentagent.com. Loading the app from the 47abc6db host triggers CORS failures because the cross-domain backend returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with credentials. App works fully when loaded from the youth-worx-connect URL. Recommend the main agent verify which preview URL is canonical and align both.
Backend RSVP endpoints (/api/events/{id}/rsvp) still exist but are unused by the new EventsPage UI — fine for now, but flag for cleanup if no longer needed.
